## AYORAI Engineering PR

### Scope
- [ ] Research/documentation only
- [ ] Runtime code
- [ ] Security control
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Evidence/audit

### Validation
- [ ] Automated checks pass
- [ ] Negative/failure cases considered
- [ ] Security claims remain scoped
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data
- [ ] Existing deployed site remains unaffected unless explicitly stated

### Evidence
Describe tests, workflow runs, benchmarks or documentation evidence.

### Safety
High-impact enforcement is not introduced without threat-model and review coverage.
